questions.question: God sent Jonah to preach against the great city of Nineveh. What reason did God give?

answers.text: Its wickedness has come up before Him
Its king has turned his back on Him
Its people have mocked all His prophets

questions.question: During a violent storm at sea, how did the sailors find out who was responsible for it?
When the sailors on the ship asked Jonah about himself, how did he describe the LORD he worships?

answers.text: The God who made the sea and the dry land
The God who rules from the temple in Jerusalem
The God who led Israel out of the land of Egypt

questions.question: After the sailors threw Jonah into the sea during a great storm, the sea kept on raging. True or false?
